description: This file defines configuration interfaces, default configuration, environment variable overrides, and functions to load and build configuration objects for a web application, specifically related to Redis, logging, JWT, and socket settings.

methods.name: defaultConfig
methods.description: Returns the default configuration object with preset values for server, Redis, JWT, and logging settings.

methods.name: configFromFile
methods.description: Attempts to load configuration from a JSON file, depending on the environment, and returns a partial configuration object.

methods.name: applyEnvOverrides
methods.description: Overrides configuration values with environment variables if they are set and valid.

methods.name: buildConfig
methods.description: Merges default configuration with file-based configuration and applies environment variable overrides to produce the final configuration object.
